newsitem.title: UZBEKISTAN: Uzbek copper, gold tender to be known in May.
newsitem.headline: Uzbek copper, gold tender to be known in May.

text.p: Results of a tender in Uzbekistan for seven gold fields boasting reserves of 1,720 tonnes of gold and four million tonnes of copper will be made known in May, an Uzbek official said on Thursday.
"Results of the tender will be officially announced at the beginning of May," Alexander Ogarkov, chairman of the state committee for geological and mineral resources, told reporters.
He said the tender's deadline had been extended to allow more companies to take part.
The largest gold field in the tender is Dzhetymtauskaya, with reserves estimated by the committee at be about 400 tonnes.
The richest copper-bearing field is Karamurunskaya, with reserves of 2.5 million tonnes of copper and 250 tonnes of gold.
The 17 companies competing include Britain's RTZ Corp Plc, Canada's Nelson Gold and Australia's Broken Hill Propriety Company Ltd.
